speaker: Leah Cheshier
text: What is something that the public might be surprised to learn about from astronaut training for Artemis missions?

speaker: Debra O’Connell
text: I think the most surprising thing is how little of our training I want them to use in flight.

speaker: Debra O’Connell
text: Like we spend most of our time training worst case scenarios, different failure things that could go wrong, and ideally nothing-

speaker: Debra O’Connell
text: Nothing off nominal happens during the mission. But by practicing all of those failures, they’re learning the process. They’re working as a team. There’s a lot of skills that are applicable, but the exact scenarios we train, I hope they never use it.
